title: Dedicated autoscaler: improved burst controls and utilization reporting
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleets experienced intermittent latency spikes under bursty traffic. Current token-bucket burst controls did not account for cross-fleet priority routing and underreported real utilization in long-tail scenarios. This PR: (1) introduces a smoother burst-token refill policy with configurable smoothing window to reduce abrupt queueing, (2) adds a backpressure signal and dequeue-priority hints so higher-tier customers receive throughput guarantees during contention, and (3) improves utilization reporting to include per-fleet observed vs. provisioned token-hours and queueing latency percentiles. Design summary: - autoscaler/service: refactor tokenbucket to TokenSmoother with exponential moving average refill and a tunable smoothing_ms. - routing: attach priority_hint to requests so scheduler can preempt lower-priority queued work when capacity is limited. - metrics: new autoscaler_utilization_prometheus exporter with metrics: dedicated_autoscaler_observed_token_hours_total, dedicated_autoscaler_provisioned_token_hours_total, dedicated_autoscaler_queue_latency_p95_seconds. - config: add burst.smoothing_window_ms and burst.priority_fallback_policy to DedicatedFleetSpec. Migration & rollout: feature gated behind "dedicated.autoscaler.v2" flag. Default behavior matches existing tokenbucket. Gradual rollout: enable for Canary fleets (tag: canary-autoscaler) then 25% of production fleets, monitor queue latency and error rates for 48h before full rollout. Backwards compatibility: config defaults are safe; operators can opt into new smoothing or keep legacy tokenbucket. Testing: unit tests for TokenSmoother (edgecases: zero refill, negative budgets), integration tests covering priority fallback and preemption, e2e test simulating burst traffic with mixed priority groups. Observability: dashboards updated to include utilization ratio (observed / provisioned) and queue latency heatmaps. Checklist:
- [x] Implementation complete
- [x] Unit + integration tests added
- [x] E2E scenario added in perf-canary
- [x] Docs + console dashboard updated
- [x] Feature gated and rollout plan documented
References: Linear ENG-7892, incident INT-2026-02-06 (latency spike).

release_notes:
- Autoscaler: smoother burst refill policy (configurable) to reduce queueing spikes.
- Routing: per-request priority hints and preemption for throughput guarantees.
- Metrics: added observed/provisioned token-hours and queue latency p95 for better utilization reporting.
- Rollout: behind feature flag dedicated.autoscaler.v2; gradual canary rollout planned.
